name: hyperframes-highlights
description: @realiracing highlight reel (HyperFrames: HTML + GSAP). Replaces the former Remotion project.

scripts.check: npm run check:16x9 && npm run check:9x16 && npm run check:1x1
scripts.render:16x9: node scripts/build.mjs 16x9 && npx --yes hyperframes@0.8.149 render --output renders/highlights-16x9.mp4
scripts.render:9x16: node scripts/build.mjs 9x16 && npx --yes hyperframes@0.8.149 render --output renders/highlights-9x16.mp4
scripts.render:1x1: node scripts/build.mjs 1x1 && npx --yes hyperframes@0.8.149 render --output renders/highlights-1x1.mp4
scripts.render:all: npm run render:16x9 && npm run render:9x16 && npm run render:1x1
